item.title: Project: Configurable UI Widget Framework
item.description: A reusable frontend framework for rapidly building modular widgets with standardized configuration, lifecycle management, data loading, error handling, and shared UI behavior. Built with Angular, TypeScript, RxJS.

item.title: Project: Accessible Reorder Component
item.description: A fully accessible reorder component designed for both pointer and keyboard interactions, with strong focus management and assistive technology support. Built with Angular, TypeScript, HTML, CSS.

item.title: Project: High-Throughput Spring Boot Architecture
item.description: A Spring Boot application designed and benchmarked for high request volumes, focusing on scalability, resilience, concurrency, observability, and performance tuning. Built with Java, Kotlin, Spring Boot, Apache Kafka, Docker, Microsoft Azure, Grafana, Micrometer.

item.title: Project: PSD2 API Integration
item.description: A sandbox-based PSD2 integration demonstrating secure OAuth 2.0 authorization, external account connectivity, transaction retrieval, and normalized API processing. Built with Kotlin, Java, Spring Boot, OAuth, REST API.
